oracle_note: Two clicks, pinned by hand and visible here. This clip is a woman AND a child, touching, so the reference alpha is one connected blob with one interior peak; the default single-click oracle returns one person against a two-person reference and scores catastrophically (MAD 59, boundary-F 0.18) for a reason that has nothing to do with matte quality. Rather than tune a heuristic until it happens to split them - fitting the benchmark to the pipeline - the clicks are written down. Both are given identically to every method.
